name: Kitchen wall shelf (design)
description: Small floating shelf on brackets (IKEA BERGSHULT / BURHULT style, easy to put up yourself) with things on it: cups, pantry jars (rice, pasta, lentils ...), bottles, plates on edge, bowls, a teapot, a trailing plant or herbs.
